messages.author: 6cdca9a5369ad9b8
messages.subject: [PATCH] Fix compilation with OpenJDK
parts:
This patch removes an unused import that breaks compilation with OpenJDK:

[ERROR] Failed to execute goal org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-compiler-plugin:2.3.2:compile (default-compile) on project renjin-core: Compilation failure
[ERROR] /home/penberg/renjin/core/src/main/java/r/base/Base.java:[35,69] package com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.unmarshaller.XsiNilLoader does not exist
[ERROR] -> [Help 1]

Signed-off-by: Pekka Enberg <pen...@kernel.org>
---
core/src/main/java/r/base/Base.java | 2 --
1 files changed, 0 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/core/src/main/java/r/base/Base.java b/core/src/main/java/r/base/Base.java
index 1baf592..4669106 100644
--- a/core/src/main/java/r/base/Base.java
+++ b/core/src/main/java/r/base/Base.java
@@ -32,8 +32,6 @@ import org.netlib.lapack.LAPACK;
import org.netlib.util.doubleW;
import org.netlib.util.intW;

-import com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.unmarshaller.XsiNilLoader.Array;
-
import r.base.matrix.Matrix;
import r.base.matrix.MatrixBuilder;
import r.lang.AtomicVector;
--
1.7.6.4

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Fix compilation with OpenJDK
parts:
Applied!
Huge thanks for the rapid fix.

P.S. Have you tried Renjin on JATO? I noticed that there is work being
done on using SSA instructions, which in principle could provide a
boost for some of the more math intensive parts of Renjin.

Best,

Alex
